item.text:
{"program":"domain(person,[sage,harlem,victor,kellan]).
% Sage honors tradition.
axiom(s1, honors_tradition(sage)).
% Harlem does not appreciate oddities.
axiom(s2, not(appreciates_oddities(harlem))).
% Victor honors tradition.
axiom(s3, honors_tradition(victor)).
% Victor either has a rich imagination or lacks original thought, but not both.
axiom(s4, xor(rich_imagination(victor), lacks_original_thought(victor))).
% Everyone who holds sentimental items either respects heritage or values family legacies (or both).
axiom(s5, rule([holds_sentimental_items(X)], or(respects_heritage(X), values_family_legacies(X)))).
% If Victor lacks original thought, then he either follows conventions or thinks critically, but not both.
axiom(s6, rule([lacks_original_thought(victor)], xor(follows_conventions(victor), thinks_critically(victor)))).
% Anyone who has a rich imagination and values family legacies draws from their experiences.
axiom(s7, rule([and(rich_imagination(X), values_family_legacies(X))], draws_from_experiences(X))).
% If someone observes details and seeks new experiences, then they can find unique inspirations.
axiom(s8, rule([and(observes_details(X), seeks_new_experiences(X))], finds_unique_inspirations(X))).
% Everyone either draws from their experiences or produces exceptional work, but not both is not necessarily true, rather they can be separate.
axiom(s9, forall(var(x,person), or(draws_from_experiences(var(x)), produces_exceptional_work(var(x))))).
% Everyone who keeps family heirlooms either respects heritage or admires past generations (or both).
axiom(s10, rule([keeps_family_heirlooms(X)], or(respects_heritage(X), admires_past_generations(X)))).
% Victor follows conventions or breaks rules.
axiom(s11, or(follows_conventions(victor), breaks_rules(victor))).
% If Victor either dreams vividly or thinks outside conventions (but not both), then he has a rich imagination.
axiom(s12, rule([xor(dreams_vividly(victor), thinks_outside_conventions(victor))], rich_imagination(victor))).
% Harlem either has a rich imagination or lacks original thought, but not both.
axiom(s13, xor(rich_imagination(harlem), lacks_original_thought(harlem))).
% If Kellan is a creative person, then he finds unique inspirations and produces exceptional work.
axiom(s14, rule([creative_person(kellan)], and(finds_unique_inspirations(kellan), produces_exceptional_work(kellan)))).
% If Victor is sentimental, then he either values family legacies or loves antiques, but not both.
axiom(s15, rule([sentimental(victor)], xor(values_family_legacies(victor), loves_antiques(victor)))).
% If Victor perseveres, then he will produce exceptional work.
axiom(s16, rule([perseveres(victor)], produces_exceptional_work(victor))).
% Victor cherishes memories.
axiom(s17, cherishes_memories(victor)).
% Anyone who obeys rules and avoids risks follows conventions.
axiom(s18, rule([and(obeys_rules(X), avoids_risks(X))], follows_conventions(X))).
% If Kellan respects his heritage, then he either honors tradition or cherishes memories (but not both).
axiom(s19, rule([respects_heritage(kellan)], xor(honors_tradition(kellan), cherishes_memories(kellan)))).
% Sage follows conventions or breaks rules.
axiom(s20, or(follows_conventions(sage), breaks_rules(sage))).
% If Victor is a creative person, then he finds unique inspirations and produces exceptional work.
axiom(s21, rule([creative_person(victor)], and(finds_unique_inspirations(victor), produces_exceptional_work(victor)))).
% If Victor respects his heritage, then he either honors tradition or cherishes memories (but not both).
axiom(s22, rule([respects_heritage(victor)], xor(honors_tradition(victor), cherishes_memories(victor)))).
% Sage thinks critically.
axiom(s23, thinks_critically(sage)).
% Victor holds sentimental items.
axiom(s24, holds_sentimental_items(victor)).
% Victor thinks critically.
axiom(s25, thinks_critically(victor)).
% Victor does not break rules.
axiom(s26, not(breaks_rules(victor))).","query":"labelled_explanation(not(creative_person(victor)), Status, Package)"}
